relations.subject: Thomas Burrow
relations.evidence: Studies at Cambridge (Christ’s College) from 1927, classical and soon also Indian philology, M.A. Ph.D. 1935.

relations.subject: Thomas Burrow
relations.evidence: In 1935-37 Research Fellow of his College.

relations.subject: Thomas Burrow
relations.role: Assistant Keeper of Oriental printed books and Manuscripts
relations.evidence: In 1937-44 Assistant Keeper of Oriental printed books and Manuscripts in British Museum.

relations.subject: Thomas Burrow
relations.evidence: In 1938-48 also an additional Lecturer in Sanskrit at S.O.A.S.

relations.subject: Thomas Burrow
relations.evidence: From 1944 Boden Professor of Sanskrit at Oxford, retired in 1976 (emeritus fellow of Balliol College).

relations.subject: Thomas Burrow
relations.evidence: and from 1949 collected with Emeneau the D.E.D .
